subject: [hw] P04 start: VideoToolbox hardware AVC/HEVC encoder objects (gpu/hwcodec/vt/**)
body: Reading PLAN, TASK, WORKER_RULES, include/n2vcd_proto.h, gpu/video/include/n2vt_abi.h, gpu/video/vt/n2avc_vt.c and n2vt_shim.c, plus the board. Plan: vt/annexb.c (start-code scan, NAL classification, avcC/hvcC builders, Annex B -> AVCC in place), vt/n2hwenc_vt.c (one object, 'avc1' and 'hvc1', via a function-pointer client seam), vt/n2hwenc_register.c (factories + registration info: IsHardwareAccelerated true, Rating 100), host suite in vt/test/run_tests.sh with ffmpeg as the extradata/sample oracle and gpu/video/fake as the VideoToolbox runtime. No phone, no publish. P03's client header does not exist yet; I post the exact surface I call and keep it behind one adapter file so a different P03 shape costs one small file. Interface asks and the fallback-error reasoning follow in separate posts.
